title: Zetta vs LOS NINOS (1082837): pick depends on a roster-backed but contested Alianza Lima Esports alias
detail: HLTV 2399865 and Hotspawn list Zetta vs LOS NINOS (CCT South America Series 7, 2026-10-21T22:00Z). The market behind the ladder pick names Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Ninos (Kalshi KXCS2GAME-26OCT211800LNALE; Polymarket cs2-ale1-ln-2026-10-21). bo3.gg shows Alianza Lima Esports fielding the identical five players as HLTV's Zetta (zockie, Slayerhz, NotJuanjo, BabyRage, Antuanette) in this event, supporting the reviewed competition-scoped alias; however Strafe lists both names as separate event competitors and some mid-event Alianza Lima lineups show 1ayala instead of Antuanette. Identity is therefore alias-dependent, not certain: treat the LOS NINOS 51.0% value as UNVERIFIED until an official org/roster source settles the naming. No replacement number is offered. The both-teams-plus-start-time join itself is now locked by regression tests (tests/test_093e722e_join_guard.py): a one-team join can never produce this pick again.

title: HOTU vs The Huns (1082792): model-only estimate; no esportsbook line exists yet at T-9 days
detail: HLTV 2399437 confirms the GLuck Moscow Cyber Games 2026 BO3 LAN semi-final on 31 Oct. At 2026-10-21T20:20Z no two-sided prematch price was verified on Polymarket, Kalshi or public esportsbook pages (EGamersWorld lists the fixture with no odds; its team '1.8' figure is a site rating, not a price, and was not used). title: New low-tier lobby fixtures (incl. DFRAG Invitational) cannot have verified lines until teams/markets exist
detail: Fixtures entering the Hotspawn lobby after the 16:02Z snapshot (production run 39628269521: 71 records, 8 upcoming, complete ladder 8/8 directional) are picked up by the next scheduled 4-hour refresh and run through the full ladder: HLTV identity, Polymarket/Kalshi both-teams joins, esportsbook pairs, consensus, then originated Valve/HLTV-ranking/bo3-form models, then guidance-only wide books. DFRAG Invitational 2026 (B-Tier LAN, Brisbane, 26 Oct-1 Nov) still lists teams as TBA on Liquipedia, so no compliant market line can exist yet; such fixtures stay blank in the Unresolved & limitations section (linked from the mobile executive summary) rather than receiving an invented percentage. There is no default 50/50 anywhere in the pipeline.
